en: A black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a rural road lined with trees leading toward a town in the distance. On the left side of the road stands a horse‑drawn covered wagon with several people beside it. Fields stretch out on the right, and beyond them lies a townscape with church towers and larger buildings on the horizon. The title in red German script is printed at the lower left.
